g.text: The median satellite fell from about 1,450 kg to 5 kg as cheap CubeSats took over. Since 2017 it has

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: climbed back to 575 kg. Leave out Starlink and the rise is still 5 kg to 267 kg.

font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17171a

g.text: Every payload launched since 1990, by year and mass

text.style: font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4741

g.text: Shading shows where each year's satellites sit (darker = more of them). Red line: the median.

text.style: font-weight: 500; font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono'; text-anchor: start; fill: #e4572e
font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #17171a
font-size: 10.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; text-anchor: start; fill: #4a4741

g.text: The rise isn't only Starlink: without it the median still climbs.
